Future<void> run(items, int width) async {
 for (final item in sessionsFor(items, 'active')) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([save(item), notify(item)]);
 }
 final batches = items.slices(width);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in batches) { await Future.wait(batch.map(save)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in List.generate(count, (i) => items.skip(i * width).take(width))) { await Future.wait(batch.map(save)); }
 for (final batch in batches) {
  for (final item in batch) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   await (save(item), notify(item)).wait;
  }
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (var i = items.length; i > 0; i -= width) { await (save(items[i-1]), notify(items[i-1])).wait; }
 for (var i = items.length; i > 0; i -= 1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([save(items[i-1])]);
 }
}
